Results.OriginalProductName: Timberline 1300 Pellet Grill - In Store Only
Results.ReviewText: 67 yr old that cooks outside 200 days a year always gas or charcoal grill kinda guy. We entertain often (20 to 20 guests) purchased a 1300 three weeks ago or 18 meals ago...while I am far from competition ready, not one bad meal has come off of that baby!!! NEVER SMOKED MEAT OF ANY TYPE prior to this journey. Now I’ll never grill again! I am now a smoker! Heck that 1300 while it could be a competition smoker could easily be dubbed “smoking for dummies” put brisket on went played golf, came home wrapped it in foil put it back on the grill, wen inside showered cleaned up guest arrived and eat a dang good brisket that I claimed to have slaved over for hours...till my wife ratted me out and talked about how easy it was! Simply stated outstanding
Results.Title: Converted gas

Results.OriginalProductName: Timberline 1300 Pellet Grill - In Store Only
Results.ReviewText: My Timberline 1300 has been absolutely amazing from the moment of putting it together which was really easy all the way to cooking just about everything you could dream of on it. I've cooked in every type of weather you can imagine including snow, rain, 40+ mph winds and even scorching 104 degree days. The Timberline 1300 has not once let me down or given me any issues with it's amazing design. The WiFire technology makes it so easy to monitor everything about the cook and really comes in useful when we use the Timberline in a competition environment where temps and timing are key to success. It's spacious and allows a huge load of meat, yet can also handle a smaller cook for a small family dinner. It heats up quickly, runs smoothly and is very efficient in pellet consumption (I have tested it against other grills and brands). You really can't go wrong, and should anything happen, the 3 year warranty and amazing customer service are there for you.
Results.Title: One Amazing Grill!

Results.OriginalProductName: Timberline 1300 Pellet Grill - In Store Only
Results.ReviewText: I bought this grill last October. When I bought it it needed an upgrade to the firmware. I had to actually bring it into the house and set my Wi-Fi next to the grill for it to upgrade it took over a week talking with everyone there to be able to to get it to upgrade. They could only upgrade it the next day there was no one there that could send the upgrade. The  The problem is now the button to turn off the grill is right next to the disconnect button. Recommend you never use the app without wearing your glasses. That and then I have itself really should not be that big a deal however before I reconnected the grill I upgraded my Wi-Fi. I cannot longer connect my grill  to my phone or to my Wi-Fi. If you’re buying this grill because you want this feature don’t. The support for the bugs on it is ridiculous.  I think whoever created this part on their grill Must have  come from AT&T.    I highly recommend the grills they are wonderful to cook with slow fast it’s a great grill and tell you want to use the Wi-Fi what are their waste of money .  If you went up purchasing this particular grill plan on spending hours on the phone trying to get it to hook up.
Results.Title: If you’re buying this grill for the Wi-Fi  don’t

Results.OriginalProductName: Timberline 1300 Pellet Grill - In Store Only
Results.ReviewText: I bought this two weeks ago. This is my initial thoughts. I have never owned a smoker before. My first one I bought was a green mountain about three weeks ago. That unit has since been returned due to the pellet drive breaking new out of the box. I went a purchased the timberline 1300. Hands down a way better build smoker. I went from spending $750 to spending $2,500 after the grill and accessories and I don't regret one bit of it. I have used this grill 12 out of the last 14 days. Even learning how to cook with the smoker, I have yet to have one bad tasting item come from the grates. On a negative side for the Traeger the green mountain heated up faster. But this grill stays more consistent temp.

Results.OriginalProductName: Timberline 1300 Pellet Grill - In Store Only
Results.ReviewText:
Owning the Redfish Lodge Of Louisiana we entertain clients constantly and a big part of our clients trip is enjoying south Louisiana cuisine.
Prior to owning my first Traeger I always cooked on a gas grill. WOW how did I ever go that long without owning a pellet grill from Traeger.......Life is much easier when cooking on the Timberline 1300. I tell everyone it is so simple to use. Just set it and leave it!
From fish, crabs, shrimp, meats, chicken, you name it, the flavors that the Timberline 1300 infuse to your foods is incredible.
The fact that you can cook for large or small groups is such a plus.
Now add all the bells and which are mind blowing especially the WIFIRE technology where you can track what’s cooking and save the information for a later day when you cook the same thing again. 
Oh did I mention we love our Traeger Timberline 1300
Results.Title: Simply AWESOME!!

Results.OriginalProductName: Timberline 1300 Pellet Grill - In Store Only
Results.ReviewText: Recently purchased the Timberline and can't cook enough with it. Very convenient with the Wi/Fire tech, if you need it to run to the store or are occupied with something else around the house you can check your food just as easy as a text or email. SuperSmoke feature is great for BBQ, I was a skeptic of how much of a smoke profile this would actually generate with the meat and was put in my place.  The reverse sear on steaks with SS is great too, whole new concept for me and well worth the time it takes to prepare. We've always been big on grilling vegetables in our home too and this grill has raised the bar on flavor and texture. Only con is the grease system, it functions poorly in my opinion and keeping it clean is a constant detailed practice for safety and preventing unwanted flavor in your food, room for improvement. Only complaint is I purchased the prior generation less than 3 months before the current updates to the drive and other small features were made, would have waited if I knew on a purchase like this.
Results.Title: Best Pellet Grill You'll Find

Results.OriginalProductName: Timberline 1300 Pellet Grill - In Store Only
Results.ReviewText: I've had my Timberline for over a year now and it is the finest cooker I've ever owned.  As a loyal Traeger owner since 2002, I've had a few different models, but this thing is a completely new level of quality and consistency.  The insulation holds temperatures better and burns less pellets.  The new smoke flow adds even more flavor.  And, the wifi controller keeps me connected to my grill from anywhere.  Well done!
Results.Title: Insanely Consistent!

Results.OriginalProductName: Timberline 1300 Pellet Grill - In Store Only
Results.ReviewText:
As a cattle rancher and professional hunter, making sure the meat I serve to my family is of the highest possible standard is critical to honoring the animal that meat came from. Since using the timberline I haven’t ruined a single meal. By being able to monitor and change the temperature of the grill and the meat from inside my house, at work, or even from another state (I’ve done it) I know exactly what is going on with the food I’m making. And it’s delicious. 
•easy to use
•low maintenance
•never burns food
•makes food taste great
I strongly endorse this product.
Results.Title: Never burn a meal again
